about: Real captures used on the marketing site: the Galley app (public/screens/ showcase, public/docs/ the docs pages' pictures, public/howto/ the how-to steps) and the Caddow example site itself (public/sites/). Every one comes from scripts/capture-screens.mjs, run against a live Galley with throwaway copies of the fashion starter (Caddow) and the small-business starter (Lowfield, the target of the WordPress move), a stand-in Cloudflare and a stand-in WordPress site. 1440 × 900 window at 2× device scale, light theme, WebP, with a 1× copy (<name>@1x.webp). Showcase and how-to pictures are kept under about 160 KB (quality is lowered before anything is shrunk); docs pictures are cut to the exact size their page declares and kept under 120 KB.
setup: Everything throwaway lives in /tmp/galley-capture-2: HOME=/tmp/galley-capture-2/home, GALLEY_HOME=/tmp/galley-capture-2/galley-home; the sites are $HOME/sites/caddow and $HOME/sites/lowfield.

Sites: node packages/cli/bin/galley.js new caddow --starter caddow --no-install --no-start --dir $HOME/sites (and lowfield --starter lowfield); link node_modules from starters/astro-editorial and starters/astro-starter, add node_modules to each site's .git/info/exclude, set git user.name/email to Tobiah Rusk <tobiah@caddow.example>.

Servers (clean environment, throwaway home): /tmp/galley-capture-2/start.sh hosts (stand-in Cloudflare on 4791), start.sh wp (stand-in WordPress on 4792: --posts 12 --pages 6 --elementor 2), start.sh galley (Galley on 4790 for the Caddow site, the assistant key passed to that process only; GALLEY_DEPLOY_CLOUDFLARE_API and GALLEY_DEPLOY_PROBE point at the stand-in). PIDs in /tmp/galley-capture-2/pids/.
Open the second site: POST /api/sites/open {"path":"/tmp/galley-capture-2/home/sites/lowfield"}; site ids: GET /api/sites. The token is the one in the Open: link the server prints.
command: GALLEY_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4790 GALLEY_TOKEN=<token> GALLEY_SITE=<caddow id> SITE_DIR=/tmp/galley-capture-2/home/sites/caddow WP_SITE=<lowfield id> WP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4792 CF_KEY=<stand-in key> PLAYWRIGHT_MODULES=<node_modules with playwright-core> node scripts/capture-screens.mjs   (no step names = the whole session in order; /tmp/galley-capture-2/cap.sh <steps> runs it with these filled in)
captured: 2026-11-24, Galley 0.1.2 (web UI built from the repository that day). Assistant spend so far: $0.56 (two readings of the brand).

screens.shows: Add many redirects with eleven pasted lines: the review catching a loop (in red), an address not on the site and a duplicate; Add 10 redirects greyed out.
Redirects, scrolled: the list of 8, Try an address answering /about-us/ → /atelier/ (Ends on “The atelier”), and Health: 1 leads nowhere.
The brand proposal read from Caddow, top of the screen: Nothing is saved yet / Save the brand, Worth a look, the first colours marked Measured or Declared.
The proposal's Type part: the three fonts as measured, and the Heading 1 specimen.
The proposal's Voice part, written by the assistant: the tone words and numbered rules with lines quoted from the site.
The Material part with a PDF of brand notes, the wordmark picture and a note added, each with its own note.
Bring your WordPress site, step 1: the stand-in WordPress address checked (Fernhill Garden Studio: 12 posts, 6 pages, 18 images, 37 comments stay behind).
Step 2 “Here’s what comes across from Fernhill Garden Studio”: the counts, where posts and pages go, the two Elementor pages.
Step 3 “Bringing it over…”: images done, posts under way.
Step 4 “Your WordPress site is here”: the five next steps and What arrived (12 posts, 5 pages, 18 images).
Arrange on the Caddow home page: Lookbook grid 3/11 selected with its toolbar, its options in the panel and the section library.
Recording (muted, loops): a Newsletter section found in the library and dragged onto the home page under the campaign hero.

The example site itself (not re-made in this pass).

notes: Each step changes the throwaway Caddow copy the way a person would; analytics, bulk-redirects, add-form, brand and search-ai each end by publishing as Tobiah Rusk (an invented person from the starter), so Version history reads as one session. The brand step makes one real assistant request (about $0.28); a proposal already read is reused unless BRAND_READ=1.

search-ai first publishes a journal post that still links to /about-us/ (now redirected), so Search & AI has a certain fix to offer. Its first run of the checks usually finds the preview's pages still compiling, so it runs them twice.
The WordPress move runs on the second site (Lowfield) and is left waiting in Proof.

Site captures are taken from the starter's own dev server; the dev server's toolbar is hidden in every capture. In arrange-drag.webm (made before that was fixed for reloads) the toolbar's pill shows at the bottom of the last frames; re-run the drag step to remove it.
Agent files are not captures: the /ai-first/ page shows this site's own files, read at build time.
